# WhatsApp Physical Qualification

Use the [complete, self-contained sitting runbook](https://github.com/division-sh/swarm/issues/2577#issuecomment-6243293343),
confirmed by [reviewer-g](https://github.com/division-sh/swarm/issues/2577#issuecomment-6243332890).
The latest #2614 landing checkpoint supplies the current source pin; replace the
packet's older source pin with that head. The commands and supplied aids are
unchanged. Do not use the superseded trial/preparation packets.

The agent rehearsal reached the first QR, expiry and replacement on the same
operation. The user's real-device P01-P09 sitting and next-day continuity check
remain unperformed. Do not record or publish QR codes, credentials, phone data
or session material. Use the runbook's quiet-host envelope and stop rules.

The paired PostgreSQL resume timeout remains the explicitly accepted residual
under [6198119875](https://github.com/division-sh/swarm/issues/2577#issuecomment-6198119875).
A recurrence reopens #2577 and blocks the next release; do not raise the bound,
retry or skip it. Keep this separate from the retained pre-QR failures.

Under the [user amendment](https://github.com/division-sh/swarm/issues/2577#issuecomment-6223240045),
the human-written upstream SDK PR is a user-owned follow-up due 2026-11-28, not
a #2614 landing condition. Preserve the single pinned-fork replace line and its
exit-condition comment until both fixes are upstream. No vendoring is authorized.
#2577 remains open for the upstream follow-up and replace-line exit.
